name: Telekinetic Attacks
body:
School transmutation; Level magus 1, psychic 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target touched weapon
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fort negates (object); Spell Resistance yes (object)

DESCRIPTION

You instill the touched weapon with extra kinetic power. The weapon deals 2 additional damage of the same type the weapon normally deals. This additional damage increases by 1 for every six levels you possess (maximum 5 damage at 18th level). A ranged weapon affected by this spell applies these effects to its ammunition. This spell cannot be cast on a natural weapon.
